Nina V.: Heads-up: sample-app ingestion broke on onboarding because SDK serialized arrays into a single string and used the wrong key. REST accepts {"inputs":[...]}, SDK sent {"input": "['a','b']"}.

Nina V.: REST quick repro: curl POST /v1/embeddings/bulk with inputs array works.

Owen L.: Which SDK/lang/version?

Nina V.: JS SDK v0.9.2. Network capture shows client calling /v1/embeddings and body.input = "[object Object]" in some cases.

Priya S.: That smells like the high-level helper only targets single-input flow. When we added /embeddings/bulk we didn't update the helpers. Also I remember an open item: retry middleware ignores Retry-After. Did you see retries?

Nina V.: Yes — hosted returned 429 Retry-After: 5 but SDK retried twice immediately and we got duplicate ingestion records. Bad for cost and idempotency.

Infra Bot: rate-limiter: api_key=* returned 429 at 1799012400, Retry-After: 5s

Owen L.: Plan: (1) add embeddings.bulk(...) to SDKs (JS/Python) that calls /v1/embeddings/bulk and sends inputs array; (2) patch serializer to not stringify arrays; (3) update retry logic to honor Retry-After and expose a retry hook; (4) add e2e test posting 3-item batch asserting no coercion.

Priya S.: I'll open an issue and tag sdk/parity and regression. Nina — please attach your curl and SDK network traces. Also add a short note in the sample-app quickstart about using REST as a temporary workaround.

Nina V.: Will do. For now patched sample-app to call the REST bulk endpoint directly. Thanks. :thumbsup:
